# `redundant-type-qualification`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports a fully qualified enum value when the result location already
establishes its type.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

An inferred `.case` literal keeps the value focused on the selected case and
avoids repeating the surrounding type annotation.

## When it fires

It applies when the declaration has an explicit result type matching the
qualification exactly.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const Color = enum { red, green };

const default: Color = Color.red;
```
